items.question: What auspicious deception of time does the speaker now wish to hear?
premises: The speaker wishes to hear now.
The object is deception of time.
items.inference: The verse requests instruction on an auspicious way of overcoming or deceiving time.
uncertainties: Whether vañcanaṃ means deception, avoidance, or transcendence of time.
items.plain_english: Now I wish to hear the auspicious deception of time.

items.question: How is death destroyed according to the teaching being given?
premises: The speaker says there is no doubt.
Death is destroyed in the manner described.
The teaching is presented as certain.
items.inference: The verse assures that death is destroyed through the method about to be explained.
uncertainties: The exact method is not stated in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: I tell you without doubt: death is destroyed.

items.question: What happens to even a wise person when nectar-tip and juice-essence burn?
premises: The nectar tip and juice essence are involved.
Even a wise person is affected.
items.inference: The verse warns that the burning process involving nectar and juice affects even the wise.
uncertainties: Whether dahyamāna modifies the wise person or the nectar/juice.
items.plain_english: Even a wise person is burning at the tip of nectar with the essence of juice.
